config.description: The schema metadata configuration to submit as a new version. Must include the existing id.

credentialConfigId.description: Optional credential config to update pinning for after successful version publish.

pinMode.description: How to update credential config pinning after version publish. keep_current: do not change existing pin (unless empty). update_to_new_version: update pinned version under current id. replace_id: repoint pin to config.id.
